# Miataru mutual navigation and visitor history (2026-01-19 19:35Z)

_**User**_

You are working in the Miataru iOS app (Swift/SwiftUI rewrite).

IMPORTANT:
- You MUST use the existing Miataru Swift client already in the repository for ALL server communication (GetLocation, GetVisitorHistory, etc.).
- Do NOT create a new networking layer and do NOT duplicate request/response models.

Context
- Navigation feature: user selects target device B, app fetches B’s location continuously via GetLocation(B) (requester deviceId = our device A).
- Server + existing Swift client support GetVisitorHistory(deviceId) that returns accesses (visitorDeviceId + timestamp).
- Device tab has a “Device QR Code” screen.
- “Add Device” already exists as its own SwiftUI View and can be invoked via the same flow used for the deep link scheme:
  - Deep link example: miataru://... passes a deviceid and opens the Add Device view with deviceId pre-filled.

Goal
Implement:
A) Mutual navigation UI state in navigation screen
B) Visitor History UI reachable from Device QR Code screen, with ability to add unknown visitor devices directly by reusing the existing Add Device deep-link flow.

A) Mutual navigation (Navigation screen)
Definition (strict):
- Mutual navigation state exists ONLY if BOTH devices actively navigate to each other:
  - We are navigating to target device B (so we regularly call GetLocation(B) with requester A)
  - AND visitor history of our own device A shows recent accesses by device B within a time window.
- No notifications.

Detection logic
- Implement isMutualNavigation(targetDeviceId: String) -> Bool:
  - navigationActiveTo(targetDeviceId) is true
  - lastSeenFromTarget = newest visitorHistory entry where visitorDeviceId == targetDeviceId
  - Use hysteresis to avoid flicker:
    - Enter if age(lastSeenFromTarget) <= T_enter (e.g. 60s)
    - Exit if age(lastSeenFromTarget) >= T_exit (e.g. 90s)
- While navigation is active:
  - Poll GetVisitorHistory(ourDeviceId) periodically (15–30s) using the existing Miataru Swift client (async/await).
  - Cache results and update UI state only if changed.
  - Ensure polling does not block map updates.

Navigation UI changes
1) Bottom status line
- Currently: “{distance} · {minutes} Min., {seconds} Sek.”
- If mutual is active, append: “ - beidseitig aktiv”
- Styling: same font size; suffix may be slightly reduced opacity.

2) Route highlight (no new pulsing, markers unchanged)
Constraints:
- Device markers already pulse.
- DO NOT add a second pulse or any additional marker animation.
- Markers remain unchanged.
- Only route/polyline should be subtly highlighted.

Requirement:
- Implement a dual-stroke route rendering when mutual is active:
  - Keep existing route stroke as base.
  - Add a thinner inner overlay stroke (or subtle outer glow + normal inner) to communicate “linked/connection”.
  - No pulsing animation.
- If route is segmented (e.g. “shadow/current position”), preserve segmentation and apply highlight consistently.

B) Visitor History UI (Device tab)
Entry point:
- On “Device QR Code” screen, add a button labeled “Besucherprotokoll”.
- Tap navigates (push) to a new screen “Besucherprotokoll”.

Visitor History screen
- On appear: fetch GetVisitorHistory(currentDeviceId) using existing Miataru Swift client.
- Show list of access entries (most recent first).
- Each row shows:
  - If visitorDeviceId matches a known device in our device list: show the device name prominently.
  - Else: show “Unbekanntes Gerät” plus shortened deviceId (e.g. first 6 + last 4).
  - Timestamp as relative (“vor 5 Min.”); optionally absolute timestamp as secondary text.
- Empty state: “Keine Zugriffe”.
- Error state: inline message + retry.

Adding unknown devices from Visitor History (MUST reuse deep-link add flow)
- For unknown visitor entries, provide a direct “Hinzufügen” action:
  - trailing button and/or swipe action labeled “Hinzufügen”.
- On tap, invoke the existing Add Device view using the SAME navigation/route mechanism used for the deep-link:
  - Construct the same route/intent/URL (miataru://...) or call the same internal handler used for deep-linking, passing the visitorDeviceId.
  - This must open the Add Device view with deviceId pre-filled.
  - Do NOT duplicate Add Device logic, do NOT create a separate add screen.
- After successful add:
  - Ensure the known devices store/state updates immediately.
  - Refresh the Visitor History screen so the previously unknown entry resolves to the newly known device name (no restart).

Engineering constraints
- Use the app’s existing architecture and routing/deep-link handling.
- Use async/await and the existing Miataru Swift client.
- All strings should be localization-ready (Localizable).
- No badges and no push notifications.
- Keep UI subtle and consistent.

Tests
- Unit tests for mutual navigation hysteresis logic.
- Unit tests for visitor row resolution (known vs unknown).
- Unit test that after “add unknown device” completes, the same visitor entry resolves to known device name (view-model/store level, mocking the devices store update).

Deliverables
1) Mutual navigation detection + polling using existing Miataru Swift client.
2) Navigation UI: “- beidseitig aktiv” suffix + dual-stroke route highlight in mutual state.
3) Device QR Code screen: “Besucherprotokoll” button.
4) Visitor History screen: list + add unknown device via deep-link reuse flow.
5) Tests described above.

        "contents": "import Foundation\n#if canImport(FoundationNetworking)\nimport FoundationNetworking\n#endif\n\n// MARK: - Local Logging Helper\n\n/// Lightweight logging helper for the Miataru client library.\n///\n/// The main application target defines its own &#96;debugLog&#96; function, but it\n/// isn't visible inside this Swift package module. To keep the recent history\n/// logging changes compiling while still emitting useful diagnostics during\n/// development, we provide a local implementation that simply prints the\n/// message in debug builds.\nprivate func debugLog(_ message: @autoclosure () -&gt; String) {\n#if DEBUG\n    print(message())\n#endif\n}\n\n/// Configuration part of the Miataru request.\npublic struct MiataruConfig: Codable {\n    let RequestMiataruDeviceID: String\n}\n\n/// Strongly typed request body for the GetLocationHistory endpoint.\nprivate struct GetLocationHistoryRequestBody: Encodable {\n    var MiataruConfig: MiataruConfig?\n    var MiataruGetLocationHistory: GetLocationHistoryPayload\n\n    enum CodingKeys: String, CodingKey {\n        case MiataruConfig\n        case MiataruGetLocationHistory\n    }\n\n    func encode(to encoder: Encoder) throws {\n        var container = encoder.container(keyedBy: CodingKeys.self)\n        if let config = MiataruConfig {\n            try container.encode(config, forKey: .MiataruConfig)\n        }\n        try container.encode(MiataruGetLocationHistory, forKey: .MiataruGetLocationHistory)\n    }\n}\n\n/// Strongly typed request body for the GetVisitorHistory endpoint.\nprivate struct GetVisitorHistoryRequestBody: Encodable {\n    var MiataruGetVisitorHistory: GetVisitorHistoryPayload\n\n    enum CodingKeys: String, CodingKey {\n        case MiataruGetVisitorHistory\n    }\n\n    func encode(to encoder: Encoder) throws {\n        var container = encoder.container(keyedBy: CodingKeys.self)\n        try container.encode(MiataruGetVisitorHistory, forKey: .MiataruGetVisitorHistory)\n    }\n}\n\n/// Payload for GetLocation request.\npublic struct GetLocationPayload: Codable {\n    public let Device: String",

        "contents": "public struct MiataruGetLocationResponse: Codable {\n    let MiataruLocation: [MiataruLocationData]\n\n    enum CodingKeys: String, CodingKey {\n        case MiataruLocation\n    }\n\n    public init(from decoder: Decoder) throws {\n        let container = try decoder.container(keyedBy: CodingKeys.self)\n        // Versuche als [MiataruLocationData?] zu decodieren\n        let rawLocations = try container.decodeIfPresent([MiataruLocationData?].self, forKey: .MiataruLocation) ?? []\n        // Filtere nil heraus\n        self.MiataruLocation = rawLocations.compactMap { $0 }\n    }\n}\n\n/// The structure of the response for a GetLocationHistory request.\npublic struct MiataruGetLocationHistoryResponse: Codable {\n    let MiataruLocation: [MiataruLocationData]\n    // We can add MiataruServerConfig here if needed in the future.\n\n    enum CodingKeys: String, CodingKey {\n        case MiataruLocation\n    }\n\n    public init(MiataruLocation: [MiataruLocationData]) {\n        self.MiataruLocation = MiataruLocation\n    }\n\n    public init(from decoder: Decoder) throws {\n        let container = try decoder.container(keyedBy: CodingKeys.self)\n\n        guard var locationsContainer = try? container.nestedUnkeyedContainer(forKey: .MiataruLocation) else {\n            self.MiataruLocation = []\n            return\n        }\n\n        var parsedLocations: [MiataruLocationData] = []\n        var index = 0\n\n        while !locationsContainer.isAtEnd {\n            do {\n                let entry = try locationsContainer.decode(MiataruLocationData.self)\n                parsedLocations.append(entry)\n            } catch {\n                debugLog(\"[MiataruAPIClient] Skipping malformed history entry at index \\(index): \\(error)\")\n                _ = try? locationsContainer.decode(SkipDecodable.self)\n            }\n            index += 1\n        }\n\n        self.MiataruLocation = parsedLocations\n    }\n}\n\n/// Represents a visitor entry from the GetVisitorHistory response.\npublic struct MiataruVisitor: Codable {\n    public let DeviceID: String",

        "contents": "- application/json\n      parameters:\n        - name: deviceID\n          in: path\n          type: string\n          required: true\n          description: the unique device ID of the device the location is requested from\n          default: \"7b8e6e0ee5296db345162dc2ef652c1350761823\"\n      responses:\n        default:\n          description: geoJSON formatted device location\n          schema:\n            $ref: '#/definitions/MiataruGetLocationGeoJSONResponse'\n  /GetLocationHistory:\n    post:\n      tags:\n      - getLocation\n      description: Location History is stored on the server only if the client told the server to do so using the “EnableLocationHistory” setting in the Location Update requests. For transitions of enabling/disabling that functionality - Everytime a Location Update is received by the server with “EnableLocationHistory=false” the server removes all stored Location History till that point. There is a server-side setting that controls up to how many Location Updates the server is storing in the Location History before it removes the oldest one. To request the Location History of a particular device the client sends the following POST request to the GetLocationHistory service URL. Please note that the MiataruConfig portion is optional.         "contents": "public struct MiataruVisitor: Codable {\n    public let DeviceID: String\n    public let TimeStamp: String\n\n    /// Computed property for accessing the timestamp as a Date.\n    public var TimeStampDate: Date {\n        if let ts = Double(TimeStamp) {\n            return Date(timeIntervalSince1970: ts)\n        } else {\n            return Date(timeIntervalSince1970: 0)\n        }\n    }\n\n    enum CodingKeys: String, CodingKey {\n        case DeviceID\n        case TimeStamp\n    }\n\n    public init(DeviceID: String, TimeStamp: String) {\n        self.DeviceID = DeviceID\n        self.TimeStamp = TimeStamp\n    }\n\n    public init(from decoder: Decoder) throws {\n        let container = try decoder.container(keyedBy: CodingKeys.self)\n        DeviceID = try container.decode(String.self, forKey: .DeviceID)\n        // TimeStamp can come as String or number\n        if let tsString = try? container.decode(String.self, forKey: .TimeStamp) {\n            TimeStamp = tsString\n        } else if let tsInt = try? container.decode(Int64.self, forKey: .TimeStamp) {\n            TimeStamp = String(tsInt)\n        } else if let tsDouble = try? container.decode(Double.self, forKey: .TimeStamp) {\n            TimeStamp = String(Int64(tsDouble))\n        } else {\n            TimeStamp = \"0\"\n        }\n    }\n\n    public func encode(to encoder: Encoder) throws {\n        var container = encoder.container(keyedBy: CodingKeys.self)\n        try container.encode(DeviceID, forKey: .DeviceID)\n        try container.encode(TimeStamp, forKey: .TimeStamp)\n    }\n}\n\n/// Server configuration information from GetVisitorHistory response.\npublic struct MiataruVisitorHistoryServerConfig: Codable {\n    public let MaximumNumberOfVisitorHistory: String",

        "contents": "    private func formattedDistance(_ meters: CLLocationDistance) -&gt; String {\n        let usesMetric: Bool\n        if #available(iOS 16.0, *) {\n            usesMetric = Locale.current.measurementSystem == .metric\n        } else {\n            usesMetric = Locale.current.usesMetricSystem\n        }\n        let value: Double\n        let unit: UnitLength\n        if usesMetric {\n            value = meters / 1000.0\n            unit = .kilometers\n        } else {\n            value = meters / 1609.344\n            unit = .miles\n        }\n        let measurement = Measurement(value: value, unit: unit)\n        let formatter = MeasurementFormatter()\n        formatter.locale = .current\n        formatter.unitStyle = .short\n        formatter.unitOptions = .providedUnit\n        let numberFormatter = NumberFormatter()\n        numberFormatter.maximumFractionDigits = 0\n        numberFormatter.minimumFractionDigits = 0\n        formatter.numberFormatter = numberFormatter\n        return formatter.string(from: measurement)\n    }\n\n    private func transportSymbolName() -&gt; String {\n        switch settings.navigationTransportType {\n        case 0: return \"figure.walk\"\n        case 2: return \"car\"\n        case 3: return \"tram\"\n        default: return \"car\"\n        }\n    }\n\n    private func updateBottomAccessory() {\n        if #available(iOS 26.0, *) {\n            let visible = (travelTime != nil || distanceText != nil)\n            routeInfoState.update(\n                etaText: travelTime,\n                distanceText: distanceText,\n                transportSymbolName: transportSymbolName(),\n                visible: visible\n            )\n        }\n    }\n    \n}",

        "contents": "    private func calculateRoute(ignoreCache: Bool = false) {\n        // Calculate a new route between user and selected device.\n        // Prefers a cached route when movement &lt; 100m; applies a daily network request limit.\n        guard let user = userCoordinate, let device = deviceCoordinate else { return }\n        // Try to reuse cached route first unless explicitly told to ignore cache\n        if !ignoreCache {\n            if useCachedRouteIfValid() { return }\n            // Only recalc when one of the positions changed since the last route calculation (or if there's no route yet)\n            let userTimestampChanged = userTimestamp != lastRouteUserTimestamp\n            let deviceTimestampChanged = deviceTimestamp != lastRouteDeviceTimestamp\n            var userCoordinatesChanged = true\n            if let lastUser = lastRouteUserCoordinate {\n                userCoordinatesChanged = (lastUser.latitude != user.latitude) || (lastUser.longitude != user.longitude)\n            }\n            var deviceCoordinatesChanged = true\n            if let lastDevice = lastRouteDeviceCoordinate {\n                deviceCoordinatesChanged = (lastDevice.latitude != device.latitude) || (lastDevice.longitude != device.longitude)\n            }\n            let transportTypeChanged = settings.navigationTransportType != lastRouteTransportType\n            let shouldRecalculate = (route == nil) || userTimestampChanged || deviceTimestampChanged || userCoordinatesChanged || deviceCoordinatesChanged || transportTypeChanged\n            if !shouldRecalculate { return }\n        }\n\n        // Enforce daily limit through centralized counter with calendar-day reset\n        routeCounter.checkAndResetIfNeeded()\n        guard routeCounter.count &lt; routeRequestDailyLimit else {\n            showErrorOverlay(\n                \"Daily route request limit reached\",",

        "contents": "    private func handleIncomingURL(_ url: URL) {\n        guard url.scheme == \"miataru\" else { return }\n        let deviceID = (url.host ?? \"\").uppercased()\n        guard !deviceID.isEmpty else { return }\n\n        Task { @MainActor in\n            // When resuming from background, SwiftUI may restore navigation state after the URL\n            // event is delivered. Deferring slightly ensures the deep link wins over restoration.\n            await Task.yield()\n            try? await Task.sleep(nanoseconds: 180_000_000)\n\n            // If the device already exists, navigate to it; otherwise fall back to add flow.\n            if KnownDeviceStore.shared.devices.contains(where: { $0.DeviceID == deviceID }) {\n                showAddDeviceSheet = false\n                pendingDeviceID = nil\n                SettingsManager.shared.lastOpenedDeviceID = deviceID\n            } else {\n                pendingDeviceID = deviceID\n                showAddDeviceSheet = true\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nprivate struct DeviceWindowEntrypoint: View {\n    @Binding var deviceID: String?\n    @Environment(\\.openWindow) private var openWindow\n    @Environment(\\.dismissWindow) private var dismissWindow\n\n    init(deviceID: Binding&lt;String?&gt;) {\n        self._deviceID = deviceID\n    }\n\n    var body: some View {\n        Group {\n            if let id = deviceID {\n                iPad_DeviceMapView(deviceID: id)\n            } else {\n                Text(NSLocalizedString(\"no_device_selected\", comment: \"No device selected for this window.\"))\n            }\n        }\n        .task {\n            if LaunchGuard.isFirstActivation {\n                LaunchGuard.isFirstActivation = false\n                openWindow(id: \"main\")\n                if let id = deviceID {\n                    dismissWindow(value: id)\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}",

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./APP_FEATURES.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {
            "line": 24
          },
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 46
          }
        },
        "contents": "- Visual effects such as pulsing accuracy circles and shimmering indicators pause automatically in Low Power Mode or while the app is in the background.\n\n**For developers:**\n- &#96;LocationManager&#96; publishes the current location, permission state, server update status, altitude, speed, battery level (when available), and a log of recent updates. It switches between high‑accuracy updates in the foreground and significant‑change monitoring in the background, requests authorization when needed, and uploads data using &#96;MiataruAPIClient&#96;.\n- Low Power Mode and scene phase changes are observed (e.g., &#96;Notification.Name.NSProcessInfoPowerStateDidChange&#96;) to gate animations like shimmer/pulsing without changing data behavior.\n- &#96;iPhone_LocationStatusView&#96; renders &#96;LocationManager&#96; diagnostics, while &#96;SettingsManager&#96; bindings immediately adjust &#96;CLLocationManager&#96; configuration.\n\n## Device Management\n**For users:**\n- Maintain a list of devices, each with a name, ID, and optional color.\n- Add devices by scanning a Miataru QR code or entering the ID manually.\n- Swipe a row to delete, edit, or start navigation, pull down to refresh locations, and the last opened device is reopened automatically on launch.\n\n- Device rows show last update time, distance, and—when available—battery level and altitude. Units adapt to your locale (metric/imperial).\n- Pull‑to‑refresh also triggers reverse geocoding for visible devices to keep place names fresh.\n\n**For developers:**\n- &#96;KnownDeviceStore&#96; persists devices in &#96;Application Support&#96; and ensures the current device is always present.\n- &#96;iPhone_DevicesView&#96; uses a &#96;NavigationStack&#96; with &#96;refreshable&#96; and notification hooks to update cached locations and remember the last opened device.\n- &#96;iPhone_AddDeviceView&#96; integrates &#96;CodeScanner&#96; to scan &#96;miataru://&#96; QR codes, offers a color picker, and prevents duplicate IDs.\n- &#96;DeviceRowView&#96; (shared) replaces &#96;iPhone_DeviceRowView&#96;, displays battery/altitude/speed when available, and uses &#96;MeasurementFormatter&#96; with the system &#96;measurementSystem&#96; for localized units.\n- &#96;DeviceNameLabel&#96; and static parts of markers are rasterized and cached to improve scrolling/rendering performance.",
        "signatures": {},

        "contents": "/*\n * Copyright (c) 2013-2025, Daniel Kirstenpfad, www.miataru.com\n *\n * DeviceGroupStore.swift\n * miataru\n *\n * Created by Daniel Kirstenpfad on 20.06.25.\n */\n\nimport Foundation\nimport UIKit\nimport Combine\n\nclass DeviceGroupStore: ObservableObject {\n    static let shared = DeviceGroupStore()\n    \n    @Published var groups: [DeviceGroup] = [] {\n        didSet {\n            setupSubscribers()\n            save()\n        }\n    }\n    private let fileName = \"deviceGroups.plist\"\n    private var cancellables: [AnyCancellable] = []\n\n    private var fileURL: URL {\n        AppDirectories.applicationSupportFile(named: fileName)\n    }\n\n    // Make init private for singleton\n    private init() {\n        self.groups = load()\n        setupSubscribers()\n    }\n\n    private func setupSubscribers() {\n        cancellables = []\n        for group in groups {\n            let c = group.objectWillChange\n                .sink { [weak self] _ in\n                    self?.save()\n                }\n            cancellables.append(c)\n        }\n    }\n\n    private func save() {\n        do {\n            let data = try NSKeyedArchiver.archivedData(withRootObject: groups, requiringSecureCoding: true)\n            try data.write(to: fileURL)\n        } catch {\n            debugLog(\"Fehler beim Speichern der DeviceGroups: \\(error)\")\n        }\n    }\n\n    private func load() -&gt; [DeviceGroup] {\n        guard let data = try? Data(contentsOf: fileURL) else { return [] }\n        do {\n            if let groups = try NSKeyedUnarchiver.unarchivedObject(ofClasses: [NSArray.self, DeviceGroup.self], from: data) as? [DeviceGroup] {\n                // Nach gespeicherter Reihenfolge sortieren\n                return groups.sorted { $0.groupPosition &lt; $1.groupPosition }\n            }\n        } catch {\n            debugLog(\"Fehler beim Laden der DeviceGroups: \\(error)\")\n        }\n        return []\n    }\n\n    func add(group: DeviceGroup) {\n        groups.append(group)\n    }\n\n    func move(fromOffsets source: IndexSet, toOffset destination: Int) {\n        groups.move(fromOffsets: source, toOffset: destination)",

        "contents": "    private func handleIncomingURL(_ url: URL) {\n        guard url.scheme == \"miataru\" else { return }\n        let deviceID = (url.host ?? \"\").uppercased()\n        guard !deviceID.isEmpty else { return }\n\n        Task { @MainActor in\n            // When resuming from background, SwiftUI may restore navigation state after the URL\n            // event is delivered. Deferring slightly ensures the deep link wins over restoration.\n            await Task.yield()\n            try? await Task.sleep(nanoseconds: 180_000_000)\n\n            // If the device already exists, navigate to it; otherwise fall back to add flow.\n            if KnownDeviceStore.shared.devices.contains(where: { $0.DeviceID == deviceID }) {\n                showAddDeviceSheet = false\n                pendingDeviceID = nil\n                SettingsManager.shared.lastOpenedDeviceID = deviceID\n            } else {\n                pendingDeviceID = deviceID\n                showAddDeviceSheet = true\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nprivate struct DeviceWindowEntrypoint: View {\n    @Binding var deviceID: String?\n    @Environment(\\.openWindow) private var openWindow\n    @Environment(\\.dismissWindow) private var dismissWindow\n\n    init(deviceID: Binding&lt;String?&gt;) {\n        self._deviceID = deviceID\n    }\n\n    var body: some View {\n        Group {\n            if let id = deviceID {\n                iPad_DeviceMapView(deviceID: id)\n            } else {\n                Text(NSLocalizedString(\"no_device_selected\", comment: \"No device selected for this window.\"))\n            }\n        }\n        .task {\n            if LaunchGuard.isFirstActivation {\n                LaunchGuard.isFirstActivation = false\n                openWindow(id: \"main\")\n                if let id = deviceID {\n                    dismissWindow(value: id)\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}",

(cached routes keyed by device/transport; distance threshold validation)\n- Utilities:\n  - &#96;thisDeviceIDManager&#96; (device ID generation + legacy migration)\n  - &#96;Haptic&#96; (feedback utilities)\n\n## 🔑 Key Features\n\n### Location Management\n- **Privacy-First**: User controls all location sharing\n- **Battery Optimized**: High-accuracy foreground; significant-change background\n- **Permission Handling**: Staged requests (WhenInUse → Always when opted-in)\n- **Background Support**: Significant-change updates\n\n### Device Management\n- **Multi-Device**: Track multiple devices\n- **Group Support**: Organize devices into groups\n- **QR Code Sharing**: Share own device, scan to add others\n- **Deep Link**: &#96;miataru://&lt;DEVICE_ID&gt;&#96;         "contents": "            .onChange(of: settings.lastOpenedDeviceID) { _, newDeviceID in\n                guard let deviceID = newDeviceID,\n                      store.devices.contains(where: { $0.DeviceID == deviceID }) else { return }\n                let requestedID = deviceID\n                Task { @MainActor in\n                    // If we’re already showing the requested device (normal in-app navigation),\n                    // do nothing to avoid a visible pop/push animation.\n                    if navigationPath.last == requestedID {\n                        return\n                    }\n\n                    // Clear first, then set after a short delay to override any restored navigation state.\n                    navigationPath = []\n                    await Task.yield()\n                    try? await Task.sleep(nanoseconds: 180_000_000)\n                    // Guard against a stale delayed task (e.g. multiple widget taps).\n                    guard settings.lastOpenedDeviceID == requestedID else { return }\n                    navigationPath = [requestedID]\n                }\n            }\n            // Intentionally do not reset didAutoNavigateFromSavedDevice on\n            // changes to lastOpenedDeviceID to avoid unintended re-pushes\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n#Preview {\n    let store = KnownDeviceStore.shared\n    store.devices = [\n        KnownDevice(name: \"iPhone 13\", deviceID: UUID().uuidString, color: .red),\n        KnownDevice(name: \"iPad Pro\", deviceID: UUID().uuidString, color: .green),\n        KnownDevice(name: \"MacBook Air\", deviceID: UUID().uuidString, color: .blue)\n    ]\n    return iPhone_DevicesView().environmentObject(store)\n}",

        "contents": "    private func handleIncomingURL(_ url: URL) {\n        guard url.scheme == \"miataru\" else { return }\n        let deviceID = (url.host ?? \"\").uppercased()\n        guard !deviceID.isEmpty else { return }\n\n        Task { @MainActor in\n            // When resuming from background, SwiftUI may restore navigation state after the URL\n            // event is delivered. Deferring slightly ensures the deep link wins over restoration.\n            await Task.yield()\n            try? await Task.sleep(nanoseconds: 180_000_000)\n\n            // If the device already exists, navigate to it; otherwise fall back to add flow.\n            if KnownDeviceStore.shared.devices.contains(where: { $0.DeviceID == deviceID }) {\n                showAddDeviceSheet = false\n                pendingDeviceID = nil\n                SettingsManager.shared.lastOpenedDeviceID = deviceID\n            } else {\n                pendingDeviceID = deviceID\n                showAddDeviceSheet = true\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nprivate struct DeviceWindowEntrypoint: View {\n    @Binding var deviceID: String?\n    @Environment(\\.openWindow) private var openWindow\n    @Environment(\\.dismissWindow) private var dismissWindow\n\n    init(deviceID: Binding&lt;String?&gt;) {\n        self._deviceID = deviceID\n    }\n\n    var body: some View {\n        Group {\n            if let id = deviceID {\n                iPad_DeviceMapView(deviceID: id)\n            } else {\n                Text(NSLocalizedString(\"no_device_selected\", comment: \"No device selected for this window.\"))\n            }\n        }\n        .task {\n            if LaunchGuard.isFirstActivation {\n                LaunchGuard.isFirstActivation = false\n                openWindow(id: \"main\")\n                if let id = deviceID {\n                    dismissWindow(value: id)\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}",

        "contents": "    private func stopNavigation() {\n        // Stop navigation without dismissing the view\n        // Clear route and navigation info, but keep the map showing both devices\n        route = nil\n        travelTime = nil\n        distanceText = nil\n        routeInfoState.hide()\n        stopAutoUpdate()\n        // Update bottom accessory to reflect that navigation is stopped\n        updateBottomAccessory()\n    }\n}\n\n// MARK: - Distance Formatting\nextension iPhone_DeviceNavigationView {\n    /// Attempts to reuse a previously calculated route if the movement since that\n    /// calculation was insignificant. Returns true if a cached route was applied\n    /// to the view state, false otherwise.\n    ///\n    /// A cached route is considered valid when BOTH endpoints (user location and\n    /// target device location) have each moved less than the configured threshold since the\n    /// route was stored.         "contents": "/*\n * Copyright (c) 2013-2025, Daniel Kirstenpfad, www.miataru.com\n *\n * iPad_RootView.swift\n * miataru\n *\n * Created by Daniel Kirstenpfad on 20.06.25.\n */\n\nimport SwiftUI\n\nstruct iPad_RootView: View {\n    var body: some View {\n        TabView {\n            iPad_DevicesView()\n                .ignoresSafeArea(.container, edges: .top)\n                .tabItem {\n                    Label(\"devices\", systemImage: \"iphone.gen3.badge.location\")\n                }\n            iPad_GroupsView()\n                .ignoresSafeArea(.container, edges: .top)\n                .tabItem {\n                    Label(\"groups\", systemImage: \"person.3\")\n                }\n            iPhone_MyDeviceQRCodeView()\n                .tabItem {\n                    Label(\"qr\", systemImage: \"qrcode\")\n                }\n            iPhone_SettingsView()\n                .navigationViewStyle(.stack)\n                .tabItem {\n                    Label(\"settings\", systemImage: \"gear\")\n                }\n        }\n        .environmentObject(DeviceGroupStore.shared)\n        .environmentObject(RouteInfoState.shared)\n        .environmentObject(SettingsManager.shared)\n        .bottomAccessory(onTap: nil)\n        .ignoresSafeArea(.all)\n        .toolbarBackground(.clear, for: .tabBar)\n        .toolbarBackground(.clear, for: .navigationBar)\n        .toolbarBackgroundVisibility(.visible, for: .tabBar)\n        .toolbarBackgroundVisibility(.visible, for: .navigationBar)\n    }\n}\n\n#Preview {\n    iPad_RootView()\n}",

        "contents": "}\n\nstruct MailView: UIViewControllerRepresentable {\n    let deviceID: String\n    let qrImage: UIImage\n\n    class Coordinator: NSObject, MFMailComposeViewControllerDelegate {\n        func mailComposeController(_ controller: MFMailComposeViewController, didFinishWith result: MFMailComposeResult, error: Error?) {\n            controller.dismiss(animated: true)\n        }\n    }\n\n    func makeCoordinator() -&gt; Coordinator { Coordinator() }\n\n    func makeUIViewController(context: Context) -&gt; MFMailComposeViewController {\n        let vc = MFMailComposeViewController()\n        vc.mailComposeDelegate = context.coordinator\n        let subject = NSLocalizedString(\"share_device_email_subject\", comment: \"\")\n        let body = String(format: NSLocalizedString(\"share_device_email_body\", comment: \"\"), deviceID, \"miataru://\\(deviceID)\")\n        vc.setSubject(subject)\n        vc.setMessageBody(body, isHTML: false)\n        if let data = qrImage.pngData() {\n            vc.addAttachmentData(data, mimeType: \"image/png\", fileName: \"device-qrcode.png\")\n        }\n        return vc\n    }\n\n    func updateUIViewController(_ uiViewController: MFMailComposeViewController, context: Context) {}\n}\n\nstruct ActivityView: UIViewControllerRepresentable {\n    let activityItems: [Any]\n    var applicationActivities: [UIActivity]? = nil\n\n    func makeUIViewController(context: Context) -&gt; UIActivityViewController {\n        UIActivityViewController(activityItems: activityItems, applicationActivities: applicationActivities)\n    }\n\n    func updateUIViewController(_ uiViewController: UIActivityViewController, context: Context) {}\n}\n\n#Preview {\n    iPhone_MyDeviceQRCodeView()\n}",

        "contents": "    private func handleIncomingURL(_ url: URL) {\n        guard url.scheme == \"miataru\" else { return }\n        let deviceID = (url.host ?? \"\").uppercased()\n        guard !deviceID.isEmpty else { return }\n\n        Task { @MainActor in\n            // When resuming from background, SwiftUI may restore navigation state after the URL\n            // event is delivered. Deferring slightly ensures the deep link wins over restoration.\n            await Task.yield()\n            try? await Task.sleep(nanoseconds: 180_000_000)\n\n            // If the device already exists, navigate to it; otherwise fall back to add flow.\n            if KnownDeviceStore.shared.devices.contains(where: { $0.DeviceID == deviceID }) {\n                showAddDeviceSheet = false\n                pendingDeviceID = nil\n                SettingsManager.shared.lastOpenedDeviceID = deviceID\n            } else {\n                pendingDeviceID = deviceID\n                showAddDeviceSheet = true\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nprivate struct DeviceWindowEntrypoint: View {\n    @Binding var deviceID: String?\n    @Environment(\\.openWindow) private var openWindow\n    @Environment(\\.dismissWindow) private var dismissWindow\n\n    init(deviceID: Binding&lt;String?&gt;) {\n        self._deviceID = deviceID\n    }\n\n    var body: some View {\n        Group {\n            if let id = deviceID {\n                iPad_DeviceMapView(deviceID: id)\n            } else {\n                Text(NSLocalizedString(\"no_device_selected\", comment: \"No device selected for this window.\"))\n            }\n        }\n        .task {\n            if LaunchGuard.isFirstActivation {\n                LaunchGuard.isFirstActivation = false\n                openWindow(id: \"main\")\n                if let id = deviceID {\n                    dismissWindow(value: id)\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}",

{
  "plan": "# Implementation Plan: Mutual Navigation and Visitor History\n\n## Overview\n\nThis plan implements two features:\n- **A) Mutual Navigation UI**: Detects when both devices are navigating to each other and shows visual indicators\n- **B) Visitor History UI**: Lists devices that have accessed our location, with ability to add unknown devices\n\n## Architecture\n\n### A) Mutual Navigation Detection\n\n**Components:**\n1. &#96;MutualNavigationDetector&#96;: ObservableObject that manages mutual navigation state\n   - Polls &#96;GetVisitorHistory&#96; every 15-30s while navigation is active\n   - Implements hysteresis logic (T_enter=60s, T_exit=90s)\n   - Caches visitor history to avoid unnecessary UI updates\n\n2. Integration in &#96;iPhone_DeviceNavigationView&#96;:\n   - Track navigation active state (view is visible and polling)\n   - Use &#96;MutualNavigationDetector&#96; to check if target device appears in visitor history\n   - Update UI when mutual state changes\n\n**Files to modify:**\n- &#96;miataru/views/iPhone/Devices Views/iPhone_DeviceNavigationView.swift&#96;\n- Create &#96;miataru/views/Common/MutualNavigationDetector.swift&#96;\n\n**UI Changes:**\n1. Bottom status line: Append \" - beidseitig aktiv\" when mutual is active\n   - Modify &#96;BottomAccessoryModifier.swift&#96; to accept optional mutual state\n   - Update &#96;RouteInfoState&#96; to include mutual navigation flag\n\n2. Route highlight: Dual-stroke rendering when mutual is active\n   - Modify route rendering in &#96;iPhone_DeviceNavigationView&#96; to add overlay stroke\n   - Preserve existing segmentation (done/todo) logic\n\n### B) Visitor History UI\n\n**Components:**\n1. &#96;iPhone_VisitorHistoryView&#96;: New SwiftUI view\n   - Fetches &#96;GetVisitorHistory&#96; on appear\n   - Displays list sorted by most recent first\n   - Shows device name if known, \"Unbekanntes Gerät\" + shortened ID if unknown\n   - Handles empty and error states\n\n2. Integration in &#96;iPhone_MyDeviceQRCodeView&#96;:\n   - Wrap in NavigationStack (if not already)\n   - Add \"Besucherprotokoll\" button\n   - Push to &#96;iPhone_VisitorHistoryView&#96; on tap\n\n3. Add Device Flow Reuse:\n   - Create helper to trigger add device flow programmatically\n   - Reuse &#96;miataruApp.handleIncomingURL&#96; logic or directly show sheet\n   - After successful add, refresh visitor history to show updated device name\n\n**Files to create:**\n- &#96;miataru/views/iPhone/iPhone_VisitorHistoryView.swift&#96;\n- &#96;miataru/views/Common/VisitorHistoryViewModel.swift&#96; (optional, for testability)\n\n**Files to modify:**\n- &#96;miataru/views/iPhone/iPhone_MyDeviceQRCodeView.swift&#96;\n- &#96;miataru/miataruApp.swift&#96; (extract deep link handler logic if needed)\n\n## Implementation Details\n\n### Mutual Navigation Detection Logic\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;swift\nfunc isMutualNavigation(targetDeviceId: String) -&gt; Bool {\n    guard navigationActiveTo(targetDeviceId) else { return false }\n    \n    let lastSeen = newestVisitorHistoryEntry(visitorDeviceId: targetDeviceId)\n    guard let lastSeen else { return false }\n    \n    let age = Date().timeIntervalSince(lastSeen.TimeStampDate)\n    \n    // Hysteresis: different thresholds for enter/exit\n    if isCurrentlyMutual {\n        return age &lt;= 90.0  // T_exit\n    } else {\n        return age &lt;= 60.0  // T_enter\n    }\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Visitor History Row Display\n\n- Known device: Show &#96;KnownDevice.DeviceName&#96; prominently\n- Unknown device: Show \"Unbekanntes Gerät\" + shortened deviceId (first 6 + last 4 chars)\n- Timestamp: Relative time (\"vor 5 Min.\") with optional absolute timestamp\n\n### Add Device Flow Reuse\n\nTwo approaches:\n1. **Direct sheet presentation** (simpler):\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;swift\n   @State private var showAddDeviceSheet = false\n   @State private var pendingDeviceID: String? = nil\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n   Show sheet with &#96;iPhone_AddDeviceView(store: KnownDeviceStore.shared, isPresented: $showAddDeviceSheet, prefillDeviceID: pendingDeviceID)&#96;\n\n2. **Deep link simulation** (reuses existing flow):\n   Create URL &#96;miataru://{deviceID}&#96; and call &#96;handleIncomingURL&#96;\n\nPrefer approach 1 for simplicity and direct control.\n\n## Testing\n\n**Unit Tests:**\n1. &#96;MutualNavigationDetectorTests&#96;:\n   - Test hysteresis logic (enter at 60s, exit at 90s)\n   - Test state transitions\n   - Test polling behavior\n\n2. &#96;VisitorHistoryViewModelTests&#96;:\n   - Test known vs unknown device resolution\n   - Test that after adding unknown device, same entry resolves to known device name\n   - Mock &#96;KnownDeviceStore&#96; updates\n\n**Test Files:**\n- &#96;miataruTests/MutualNavigationDetectorTests.swift&#96;\n- &#96;miataruTests/VisitorHistoryViewModelTests.swift&#96;\n\n## Localization\n\nAdd strings to localization files:\n- &#96;\"beidseitig_aktiv\"&#96; = \"beidseitig aktiv\" (German), \"mutual active\" (English)\n- &#96;\"besucherprotokoll\"&#96; = \"Besucherprotokoll\" (German), \"Visitor History\" (English)\n- &#96;\"unbekanntes_gerät\"&#96; = \"Unbekanntes Gerät\" (German), \"Unknown Device\" (English)\n- &#96;\"keine_zugriffe\"&#96; = \"Keine Zugriffe\" (German), \"No Access\" (English)\n- &#96;\"hinzufügen\"&#96; = \"Hinzufügen\" (German), \"Add\" (English)\n- &#96;\"vor_x_min\"&#96; = \"vor %d Min.\" (German), \"%d min ago\" (English)\n\n## File Structure\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nmiataru/\n├── views/\n│   ├── iPhone/\n│   │   ├── iPhone_MyDeviceQRCodeView.swift (modify)\n│   │   └── iPhone_VisitorHistoryView.swift (new)\n│   └── Common/\n│       ├── MutualNavigationDetector.swift (new)\n│       └── BottomAccessoryModifier.swift (modify)\n├── SettingsManagers/\n│   └── App Settings/\n│       └── RouteInfoState.swift (modify)\nmiataruTests/\n├── MutualNavigationDetectorTests.swift (new)\n└── VisitorHistoryViewModelTests.swift (new)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Implementation Order\n\n1. Create &#96;MutualNavigationDetector&#96; with polling and hysteresis logic\n2. Integrate mutual detection into &#96;iPhone_DeviceNavigationView&#96;\n3. Update bottom status line to show mutual state\n4. Implement dual-stroke route highlight\n5. Create &#96;iPhone_VisitorHistoryView&#96; with list display\n6. Add \"Besucherprotokoll\" button to QR Code screen\n7. Implement add device flow reuse\n8. Add unit tests\n9. Add localization strings",

      "codeBlock": {

        },
        "contents": "# miataru App – Feature and Developer Guide\n\nThis document lists all features offered by the miataru iOS app. Each item is described twice: once for **users** and once for **developers**. The descriptions also outline how the feature behaves in the interface so the flow from view to view is clear.\n\n## App Navigation and Views\n**For users:**\n- The app launches to a tab bar with **Devices**, **Groups**, **QR**, and **Settings** tabs. Each tab retains its own navigation stack, so returning to a tab restores where you left off.\n- Tapping a device or group drills into dedicated map screens, while the QR tab always displays your personal code for quick sharing.\n\n- On iPad, you can open a device in a new window from the list or map via context menu, or by dragging the item toward the screen edge.\n\n**For developers:**\n- &#96;iPhone_RootView&#96; constructs the &#96;TabView&#96; and hosts &#96;iPhone_DevicesView&#96;, &#96;iPhone_GroupsView&#96;, &#96;iPhone_MyDeviceQRCodeView&#96;, and &#96;iPhone_SettingsView&#96;.\n- &#96;MiataruRootView&#96; selects platform‑specific root containers so iPad and Mac can embed their own navigation styles.\n- iPad supports opening device detail windows using a value‑based &#96;WindowGroup(for: String)&#96; and context menu/drag interactions.\n\n## Location Tracking\n**For users:**\n- Enable background and foreground tracking in *Settings* to share your location with a Miataru server.\n- The app sends updates even with the screen locked and records a log of recent updates.\n- Location sharing can store history on the server and works offline until network connectivity resumes.\n- Tracking accuracy, activity type, and sensitivity are configurable in *Settings*, and a \"Location Tracking Details\" page shows the last GPS and server updates.\n\n- When supported by your device/client, the app also submits altitude (above sea level), speed, and battery level with location updates.\n- Visual effects such as pulsing accuracy circles and shimmering indicators pause automatically in Low Power Mode or while the app is in the background.\n\n**For developers:**\n- &#96;LocationManager&#96; publishes the current location, permission state, server update status, altitude, speed, battery level (when available), and a log of recent updates. It switches between high‑accuracy updates in the foreground and significant‑change monitoring in the background, requests authorization when needed, and uploads data using &#96;MiataruAPIClient&#96;.",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [

          },
          {
            "text": "## Location Tracking",

          {
            "text": "**For users:**",

        "contents": "/*\n * Copyright (c) 2013-2025, Daniel Kirstenpfad, www.miataru.com\n *\n * iPhone_5_OnboardingQRcodeView.swift\n * miataru\n *\n * Created by Daniel Kirstenpfad on 20.06.25.\n */\n\nimport SwiftUI\n\nstruct iPhone_5_OnboardingQRcodeView: View {\n    var body: some View {\n        VStack(spacing: 32) {\n            Spacer()\n            Text(\"Share &amp; Scan with QR-Codes\")\n                .font(.largeTitle)\n                .fontWeight(.bold)\n            Image(\"qrcode\")\n                .resizable()\n                .scaledToFit()\n                .frame(maxWidth: 300)\n                .padding(.horizontal)\n                .accessibilityHidden(true)\n            Text(\"Easily share your device ID or add others by scanning QR-Codes.\")\n                .font(.body)\n                .multilineTextAlignment(.center)\n                .padding(.horizontal)\n            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 8) {\n                Text(\"To share:\").bold().font(.headline)\n                Text(\"Show your QR-Code to someone you trust.\").font(.subheadline)\n                Text(\"To add:\").bold().font(.headline)\n                    Text(\"Scan a QR-Code from another device running Miataru.\")\n                }.padding(.horizontal,10)\n            Text(\"\").padding(.bottom,16)\n            Spacer()\n        }\n        .padding()\n        .background(Color(.systemBackground))\n    }\n}\n\n#Preview {\n    iPhone_5_OnboardingQRcodeView()\n}",

        "contents": "}\n\nstruct MailView: UIViewControllerRepresentable {\n    let deviceID: String\n    let qrImage: UIImage\n\n    class Coordinator: NSObject, MFMailComposeViewControllerDelegate {\n        func mailComposeController(_ controller: MFMailComposeViewController, didFinishWith result: MFMailComposeResult, error: Error?) {\n            controller.dismiss(animated: true)\n        }\n    }\n\n    func makeCoordinator() -&gt; Coordinator { Coordinator() }\n\n    func makeUIViewController(context: Context) -&gt; MFMailComposeViewController {\n        let vc = MFMailComposeViewController()\n        vc.mailComposeDelegate = context.coordinator\n        let subject = NSLocalizedString(\"share_device_email_subject\", comment: \"\")\n        let body = String(format: NSLocalizedString(\"share_device_email_body\", comment: \"\"), deviceID, \"miataru://\\(deviceID)\")\n        vc.setSubject(subject)\n        vc.setMessageBody(body, isHTML: false)\n        if let data = qrImage.pngData() {\n            vc.addAttachmentData(data, mimeType: \"image/png\", fileName: \"device-qrcode.png\")\n        }\n        return vc\n    }\n\n    func updateUIViewController(_ uiViewController: MFMailComposeViewController, context: Context) {}\n}\n\nstruct ActivityView: UIViewControllerRepresentable {\n    let activityItems: [Any]\n    var applicationActivities: [UIActivity]? = nil\n\n    func makeUIViewController(context: Context) -&gt; UIActivityViewController {\n        UIActivityViewController(activityItems: activityItems, applicationActivities: applicationActivities)\n    }\n\n    func updateUIViewController(_ uiViewController: UIActivityViewController, context: Context) {}\n}\n\n#Preview {\n    iPhone_MyDeviceQRCodeView()\n}",

        "contents": "/*\n * Copyright (c) 2013-2025, Daniel Kirstenpfad, www.miataru.com\n *\n * iPhone_RootView.swift\n * miataru\n *\n * Created by Daniel Kirstenpfad on 20.06.25.\n */\n\nimport SwiftUI\n\nstruct iPhone_RootView: View {\n    @ObservedObject private var settings = SettingsManager.shared\n    @State private var selectedTab = 0\n\n    var body: some View {\n        TabView(selection: $selectedTab) {\n            iPhone_DevicesView()\n                .tabItem {\n                    Label(\"devices\", systemImage: \"iphone.gen3.badge.location\")\n                }\n                .tag(0)\n            iPhone_GroupsView()\n                .tabItem {\n                    Label(\"groups\", systemImage: \"person.3\")\n                }\n                .tag(1)\n            iPhone_MyDeviceQRCodeView()\n                .tabItem {\n                    Label(\"qr\", systemImage: \"qrcode\")\n                }\n                .tag(2)\n            iPhone_SettingsView()\n                .tabItem {\n                    Label(\"settings\", systemImage: \"gear\")\n                }\n                .tag(3)\n        }\n        .environmentObject(DeviceGroupStore.shared)\n        .environmentObject(RouteInfoState.shared)\n        .environmentObject(SettingsManager.shared)\n        .bottomAccessory(onTap: nil)\n        .adaptiveToolbarBackground()\n        .onChange(of: settings.lastOpenedDeviceID) { _, newValue in\n            if newValue != nil {\n                selectedTab = 0\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n#Preview {\n    iPhone_RootView()\n}",

        "contents": "- Add other devices by scanning their Miataru QR code.\n- The QR tab offers one‑tap sharing, and the add‑device sheet guides scanning and rejects non‑Miataru codes.\n\n- The share sheet includes additional options, and email sharing attaches the QR image reliably.\n\n**For developers:**\n- &#96;iPhone_MyDeviceQRCodeView&#96; renders customizable QR codes using the &#96;QRCode&#96; package and supports &#96;ShareLink&#96; and &#96;MFMailComposeViewController&#96;.\n- &#96;iPhone_AddDeviceView&#96; validates the &#96;miataru://&#96; prefix from scanned codes before accepting an ID and allows manual entry with color selection.\n\n## Onboarding Flow\n**For users:**\n- A six‑step wizard guides through welcome, permissions, server URL, history settings, personal QR code display, and completion.\n- Each step shows illustrations and contextual explanations; server selection validates custom HTTPS URLs, and completion flag controls whether the wizard reappears on next launch.\n\n**For developers:**\n- Platform‑specific containers (&#96;iPhone_OnboardingContainerView&#96;, &#96;iPad_OnboardingContainerView&#96;, &#96;Mac_OnboardingContainerView&#96;) embed the individual onboarding pages and update &#96;SettingsManager&#96; and &#96;UserDefaults.hasCompletedOnboarding&#96; as the user progresses.\n\n## Settings and Configuration\n**For users:**\n- Control tracking, data retention, server URL, device autolock, accuracy indicators, map type, zoom level, update interval, group zoom‑to‑fit, off‑screen arrows, auto‑refresh, reverse geocoding threshold, navigation mode, and route progress.\n- View location tracking details or replay the onboarding wizard.\n- Settings are grouped into tracking, app behavior, map configuration, and navigation sections for easier discovery.\n\n- All app preferences are also available in the system Settings app.\n- New options include: navigation route auto‑update, route progress visualization toggle, a global pulsing/shimmer switch for map markers, and off‑screen arrow visibility.\n- Bicycle transport mode was removed; existing values fall back to walking for directions and car icons where applicable.\n\n**For developers:**\n- &#96;SettingsManager&#96; stores all preferences in &#96;UserDefaults&#96; and triggers side effects such as permission checks and auto‑refresh.",

## Updates

1. **Platform support section**: Added a note that `iPhone_DeviceNavigationView` and `iPhone_MyDeviceQRCodeView` are shared between iPhone and iPad, so the implementation works on both.

2. **File notes**: Marked relevant files as "(shared, works on both platforms)".

3. **File structure**: Added a note explaining that views with the "iPhone_" prefix are shared and adapt automatically.

**Findings:**
- `iPhone_DeviceNavigationView` is used on iPad via `iPad_DevicesView` navigation destination (line 198)
- `iPhone_MyDeviceQRCodeView` is used directly in `iPad_RootView` (line 25)
- No separate iPad implementations are needed; the views adapt automatically

The plan now reflects that both features (mutual navigation and visitor history) will work on iPhone and iPad without additional platform-specific code.

        "contents": "### Comment Guidelines\n- Provide clear, descriptive English text in the comment parameter\n- Use proper English grammar and punctuation\n- Make the comment self-explanatory for translators\n- Avoid technical jargon in comments\n\n### Adding New Localized Strings\n1. Add the &#96;NSLocalizedString&#96; call in your Swift code\n2. Add the key-value pair to &#96;Localizable.xcstrings&#96;\n3. Provide translations for all supported languages (en, de, ja)\n\n## File Naming Conventions\n\n### Directory Structure\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nmiataru/\n├── views/\n│   ├── iPhone/\n│   ├── iPad/\n│   ├── Mac/\n│   └── Common/\n├── LocationManagers/\n├── SettingsManagers/\n└── Libraries/\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### File Naming\n- iPhone views: &#96;iPhone_ViewName.swift&#96;\n- iPad views: &#96;iPad_ViewName.swift&#96;\n- Mac views: &#96;Mac_ViewName.swift&#96;\n- Common/Shared views: &#96;ViewName.swift&#96;\n- Group related files in descriptive directories\n- Use clear, descriptive names for files\n- Follow the established pattern for platform-specific views\n\n## Copyright Header Requirements\n\n### Mandatory Copyright Header\n**ALWAYS** add the following copyright header to the top of every new Swift file:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;swift\n/*\n * Copyright (c) 2013-2025, Daniel Kirstenpfad, www.miataru.com\n *\n * [FileName].swift\n * miataru\n *\n * Created by Daniel Kirstenpfad on [CurrentDate].\n */\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### ✅ Correct Implementation\n&#96;&#96;&#96;swift\n/*\n * Copyright (c) 2013-2025, Daniel Kirstenpfad, www.miataru.com\n *\n * MyNewView.swift\n * miataru\n *\n * Created by Daniel Kirstenpfad on 2025-01-25.\n */\n\nimport SwiftUI\n// ... rest of the file content\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### ❌ Incorrect Implementation\n&#96;&#96;&#96;swift\nimport SwiftUI\n// Missing copyright header\n// ... rest of the file content\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Header Guidelines\n- Place the header at the very top of the file, before any imports\n- Replace &#96;[FileName]&#96; with the actual filename (e.g., &#96;MyNewView.swift&#96;)\n- Replace &#96;[CurrentDate]&#96; with the current date in format YYYY-MM-DD (e.g., 2025-01-25)\n- Keep the exact copyright text and format\n- The header must be the first content in every Swift file",

        "contents": "### Accessibility\n- Provide meaningful labels for interactive elements\n- Use semantic colors and fonts\n- Test with VoiceOver and other accessibility features\n\n### Variable Naming\n- Use camelCase for variables and functions\n- Use descriptive names that explain the purpose\n- Avoid abbreviations unless they are widely understood\n\n## Code Review Checklist\n\n- [ ] Copyright header is present and correctly formatted\n- [ ] All user-facing strings use &#96;NSLocalizedString&#96;\n- [ ] Proper error handling implemented\n- [ ] Memory leaks prevented (timers, publishers cancelled)\n- [ ] Code follows established naming conventions\n- [ ] Appropriate property wrappers used\n- [ ] Performance considerations addressed\n- [ ] Accessibility features implemented\n\n## Memories\n\n### Copyright Header Requirements\n- When new .swift files are created in the project, the cursor rules should automatically insert the standard copyright header. The date field in the header should always be set to the current date.\n\n### Commit Message Language\n- The user prefers commit messages to be written in English.\n\n### String Localization\n- The user prefers that all strings be implemented as NSLocalizedString with correct English descriptions.\n\n## Resources\n\n- [Apple Localization Guide](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/xcode/localization)\n- [SwiftUI Documentation](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/swiftui)\n- [iOS Human Interface Guidelines](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/ios)\n\n---\n\n**Remember**: Always prioritize user experience, maintainability, and code quality. When in doubt, follow the established patterns in the existing codebase.",

        "contents": "- Available in English, German, and Japanese, with dynamic type and accessibility labels and hints applied to buttons, tab items, and swipe actions.\n\n- VoiceOver support has been improved across lists and map controls. Alerts and route‑limit messages are localized.\n\n**For developers:**\n- Localizations reside in &#96;en.lproj&#96;, &#96;de.lproj&#96;, and &#96;ja.lproj&#96;. Most text uses &#96;NSLocalizedString&#96; and SwiftUI accessibility modifiers to provide labels, hints, and traits.\n- Units adapt using the system &#96;measurementSystem&#96;. New strings (e.g., daily route‑limit reached) are provided in the string catalog for all supported languages.\n\n---\nThis document serves as a comprehensive reference for both users and developers of the miataru application.",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "- Available in English, German, and Japanese, with dynamic type and accessibility labels and hints applied to buttons, tab items, and swipe actions.",

Updated the plan to require internationalization for all text. Changes:

## Updates

1. **Internationalization Requirements section**:
   - All user-facing text must use `NSLocalizedString`
   - No hardcoded strings allowed
   - All 10 supported languages listed (en, de, da, es, fi, fr, it, ja, nl, zh-Hans)

2. **Implementation requirements**:
   - Code examples showing correct `NSLocalizedString` usage
   - String key naming conventions
   - Requirement to add strings to `Localizable.xcstrings`

3. **Localization section**:
   - List of required string keys with English source values
   - Comments for translators
   - Implementation checklist

4. **Updated references**:
   - Replaced hardcoded strings (e.g., "beidseitig aktiv", "Besucherprotokoll") with references to localized strings
   - Updated examples to use `NSLocalizedString`

5. **Updated todos and implementation order**:
   - Added localization as the first step
   - Added verification task for localization
   - Updated todos to emphasize internationalization

The plan now requires that all text be internationalized and translated to all 10 supported languages before implementation.

Text(NSLocalizedString(\"location_tracking_update_sensitivity_very_sensitive_short\", comment: \"Very sensitive (3m/2m) option for location sensitivity\")).tag(1)\n                                Text(NSLocalizedString(\"location_tracking_update_sensitivity_default_short\", comment: \"Default (5m/5m) option for location sensitivity\")).tag(2)\n                                Text(NSLocalizedString(\"location_tracking_update_sensitivity_balanced_short\", comment: \"Balanced (10m/10m) option for location sensitivity\")).tag(3)\n                                Text(NSLocalizedString(\"location_tracking_update_sensitivity_battery_saver_short\", comment: \"Battery saver (25m/20m) option for location sensitivity\")).tag(4)\n         "contents": "    private func sendLocationToServer(_ location: CLLocation) {\n        guard isNetworkAvailable else {\n            debugLog(\"No network available, skipping server update.\")\n            self.serverUpdateStatus = .failed(\"No network connection\")\n            return\n        }\n        guard !settings.miataruServerURL.isEmpty,\n              let serverURL = URL(string: settings.miataruServerURL) else {\n            self.serverUpdateStatus = .failed(\"Invalid server configuration\")\n            return\n        }\n        guard let payload = sanitizedPayload(from: location) else {\n            debugLog(\"[LocationManager] Skipping server update due to invalid location values\")\n            self.serverUpdateStatus = .failed(\"Invalid location values\")\n            return\n        }\n        self.serverUpdateStatus = .updating\n        Task {\n            do {\n                let success = try await MiataruAPIClient.updateLocation(\n                    serverURL: serverURL,\n                    locationData: payload,\n                    enableHistory: settings.saveLocationHistoryOnServer,\n                    retentionTime: settings.locationDataRetentionTime\n                )\n                if success {\n                    self.serverUpdateStatus = .success\n                    self.lastServerUpdate = Date()\n                    NotificationCenter.default.post(name: .didSendOwnLocationUpdate, object: nil)\n                } else {\n                    self.serverUpdateStatus = .failed(\"Server response was not successful\")\n                }\n            } catch {\n                self.serverUpdateStatus = .failed(error.localizedDescription)\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    \n\n    /// Creates a sanitized payload to avoid encoding failures from NaN/inf values.\n    private func sanitizedPayload(from location: CLLocation) -&gt; UpdateLocationPayload? {\n        let longitude = location.coordinate.longitude",

        "contents": "/*\n * Copyright (c) 2013-2025, Daniel Kirstenpfad, www.miataru.com\n *\n * MapHelpers.swift\n * miataru\n *\n * Created by Daniel Kirstenpfad on 20.06.25.\n */\n\nimport MapKit\nimport SwiftUI\nimport CoreLocation\n\n// Helper function for MapStyle\n@available(iOS 17.0, *)\nfunc mapStyleFromSettings(_ mapType: Int) -&gt; MapStyle {\n    switch mapType {\n    case 2:\n        return .hybrid(elevation: .automatic)\n    case 3:\n        return .imagery(elevation: .automatic)\n    default:\n        return .standard(elevation: .automatic)\n    }\n}\n\n// Helper function for zoom level (in km)\nfunc spanForZoomLevel(_ zoomLevel: Int) -&gt; MKCoordinateSpan {\n    // 1° latitude ≈ 111 km\n    let km = Double(zoomLevel)\n    let delta = km / 111.0\n    return MKCoordinateSpan(latitudeDelta: delta, longitudeDelta: delta)\n}\n\n// Helper function to calculate current zoom level from span\nfunc currentZoomLevelFromSpan(_ span: MKCoordinateSpan) -&gt; Int {\n    // Average of latitude and longitude delta\n    let avgDelta = (span.latitudeDelta + span.longitudeDelta) / 2.0\n    // Convert back to km: 1° ≈ 111 km\n    let km = avgDelta * 111.0\n    return Int(round(km))\n}\n\n/// Returns a relative time string for a date (e.g. \"2 minutes ago\" or \"now\")\nfunc relativeTimeString(\n    from date: Date?,\n    to now: Date = Date(),\n    unitsStyle: RelativeDateTimeFormatter.UnitsStyle = .full,\n    timeConsideredNow: TimeInterval = 10\n) -&gt; String {\n    guard let date = date else { return \"–\" }",

1000 {\n                formattedDistance = String(format: \"%.0f %@\", distance, meterUnit)\n            } else {\n                formattedDistance = String(format: \"%d %@\", Int(round(distance / 1000)), kilometerUnit)\n            }\n        } else {\n            let feetUnit = NSLocalizedString(\"device_row_feet_unit\", comment: \"Unit for feet in device row distance display (imperial)\")\n            let milesUnit = NSLocalizedString(\"device_row_miles_unit\", comment: \"Unit for miles in device row distance display (imperial)\")\n            let distanceInFeet = distance / 0.3048\n            let distanceInMiles = distance / 1609.34\n            if distanceInFeet &gt;         "contents": "    }\n\n    private func formattedLocality(for device: WidgetDeviceData) -&gt; String {\n        let locality = device.locality ?? \"\"\n        let country = device.country ?? \"\"\n        let combined = [locality, country].filter { !$0.isEmpty }.joined(separator: \", \")\n        if combined.isEmpty {\n            return NSLocalizedString(\"widget_location_unknown\", comment: \"Shown when no placemark is available for the widget\")\n        }\n        return combined\n    }\n\n    private func formattedDistance(to device: WidgetDeviceData, from ownDevice: WidgetDeviceData?) -&gt; String {\n        guard let own = ownDevice else {\n            return NSLocalizedString(\"widget_distance_unknown\", comment: \"Shown when distance cannot be calculated\")\n        }\n        let deviceLocation = CLLocation(latitude: device.latitude, longitude: device.longitude)\n        let ownLocation = CLLocation(latitude: own.latitude, longitude: own.longitude)\n        let meters = deviceLocation.distance(from: ownLocation)\n        return distanceFormatter.string(fromDistance: meters)\n    }\n\n    private var distanceFormatter: MKDistanceFormatter {\n        let formatter = MKDistanceFormatter()\n        formatter.units = .default\n        formatter.unitStyle = .abbreviated\n        return formatter\n    }\n\n    private func formattedUpdateTimestamp(for date: Date) -&gt; String {\n        let label = NSLocalizedString(\"widget_last_update\", comment: \"Prefix for last update timestamp\")\n        let now = Date()\n        let stamp: String\n        if Calendar.current.isDate(date, inSameDayAs: now) {\n            stamp = date.formatted(date: .omitted, time: .shortened)\n        } else {\n            stamp = date.formatted(date: .abbreviated, time: .shortened)\n        }\n        return \"\\(label) \\(stamp)\"\n    }\n}\n\nstruct DeviceLocationMapWidget: Widget {\n    var body: some WidgetConfiguration {\n        ",

## Summary

### A) Mutual Navigation UI

1. **MutualNavigationDetector** (`miataru/views/Common/MutualNavigationDetector.swift`)
   - Polls `GetVisitorHistory` every 20 seconds while navigation is active
   - Hysteresis: T_enter=60s, T_exit=90s
   - Caches visitor history to avoid unnecessary UI updates

2. **Integration in iPhone_DeviceNavigationView**
   - Starts/stops monitoring in `onAppear`/`onDisappear`
   - Updates UI when mutual state changes
   - Works on both iPhone and iPad (shared view)

3. **UI Changes**
   - Bottom status line: Appends localized "mutual active" suffix when active
   - Route highlight: Dual-stroke rendering (thinner inner overlay) when mutual is active
   - Preserves existing route segmentation logic

### B) Visitor History UI

1. **iPhone_VisitorHistoryView** (`miataru/views/iPhone/iPhone_VisitorHistoryView.swift`)
   - Fetches `GetVisitorHistory` on appear
   - Displays list sorted by most recent first
   - Shows device name if known, "Unknown Device" + shortened ID if unknown
   - Handles empty and error states with retry
   - All text uses `NSLocalizedString`

2. **Integration in iPhone_MyDeviceQRCodeView**
   - Wrapped in `NavigationStack`
   - Added localized "Visitor History" button
   - Navigates to visitor history screen

3. **Add Device Flow Reuse**
   - Shows `iPhone_AddDeviceView` sheet with `prefillDeviceID` from visitor history
   - Refreshes visitor history after successful add to show updated device name

### Localization

- All 13 required strings added to `Localizable.xcstrings` for all 10 languages (en, de, da, es, fi, fr, it, ja, nl, zh-Hans)
- All user-facing text uses `NSLocalizedString` with descriptive comments
- No hardcoded strings

### Testing

- **MutualNavigationDetectorTests**: Tests hysteresis logic (enter/exit thresholds)
- **VisitorHistoryViewModelTests**: Tests known/unknown device resolution and device resolution after adding

All implementation is complete and ready for use. The features work on both iPhone and iPad since the views are shared.

        "contents": "extension MKPolyline {\n    func split(at distance: CLLocationDistance) -&gt; (MKPolyline, MKPolyline, CLLocationCoordinate2D)? {\n        guard pointCount &gt; 1 else { return nil }\n\n        var coords = [CLLocationCoordinate2D](repeating: kCLLocationCoordinate2DInvalid, count: pointCount)\n        getCoordinates(&amp;coords, range: NSRange(location: 0, length: pointCount))\n\n        var traveled: [CLLocationCoordinate2D] = [coords[0]]\n        var remaining: [CLLocationCoordinate2D] = coords\n        var accumulated: CLLocationDistance = 0\n\n        for i in 1..&lt;coords.count {\n            let start = MKMapPoint(coords[i - 1])\n            let end = MKMapPoint(coords[i])\n            let segment = start.distance(to: end)\n\n            if accumulated + segment &gt;= distance {\n                let ratio = segment &gt; 0 ? (distance - accumulated) / segment : 0\n                let interp = CLLocationCoordinate2D(\n                    latitude: coords[i - 1].latitude + (coords[i].latitude - coords[i - 1].latitude) * ratio,\n                    longitude: coords[i - 1].longitude + (coords[i].longitude - coords[i - 1].longitude) * ratio\n                )\n                traveled.append(interp)\n                remaining[0] = interp\n                let traveledPolyline = MKPolyline(coordinates: traveled, count: traveled.count)\n                let remainingPolyline = MKPolyline(coordinates: remaining, count: remaining.count)\n                return (traveledPolyline, remainingPolyline, interp)\n            }\n\n            traveled.append(coords[i])\n            remaining.remove(at: 0)\n            accumulated += segment\n        }\n\n        return nil\n    }\n}",

        "contents": "    /// and clamping of ratios to keep numerics stable when the device is far outside the region.\n    private func coordinateToScreenPoint(_ coordinate: CLLocationCoordinate2D) -&gt; CGPoint {\n        // Epsilon in degrees to prevent division by near-zero spans (≈ stability only).\n        let eps: CLLocationDegrees = 1e-9\n\n        let latDelta = max(mapRegion.span.latitudeDelta, eps)\n        let lonDelta = max(mapRegion.span.longitudeDelta, eps)\n\n        // Optional: unwrap longitude difference across the dateline so that long diffs prefer the short arc.\n        let dLon = deltaLongitude(coordinate.longitude, mapRegion.center.longitude)\n        let dLat = coordinate.latitude - mapRegion.center.latitude\n        \n        let latRatioRaw = CGFloat(dLat / latDelta)\n        let lonRatioRaw = CGFloat(dLon / lonDelta)\n\n        // Proportionally scale ratios so the largest magnitude fits within the screen bounds.\n        let maxScreens: CGFloat = 4\n        let maxRatio = max(abs(latRatioRaw), abs(lonRatioRaw))\n        let scale = (maxRatio &gt; maxScreens) ? (maxScreens / maxRatio) : 1\n        let latRatio = latRatioRaw * scale\n        let lonRatio = lonRatioRaw * scale\n\n        let screenX = screenCenter.x + lonRatio * screenSize.width\n        let screenY = screenCenter.y - latRatio * screenSize.height // Inverted Y axis\n        \n        // Debug: Print coordinate conversion details\n        debugLog(\"🌍 Device \\(deviceName) coordinate: \\(coordinate.latitude), \\(coordinate.longitude)\")\n        debugLog(\"🗺️ Map region center: \\(mapRegion.center.latitude), \\(mapRegion.center.longitude)\")\n        debugLog(\"📏 Map span: \\(mapRegion.span.latitudeDelta), \\(mapRegion.span.longitudeDelta)\")\n        debugLog(\"📊 Ratios (raw/scaled): lat=\\(latRatioRaw)→\\(latRatio), lon=\\(lonRatioRaw)→\\(lonRatio)\")\n        debugLog(\"🖥️ Screen center: \\(screenCenter), screen size: \\(screenSize)\")\n        debugLog(\"🎯 Calculated screen position: \\(screenX), \\(screenY)\")\n        \n        return CGPoint(x: screenX, y: screenY)\n    }\n    ",

        "contents": "        let options = MKMapSnapshotter.Options()\n        options.size = size\n        // WidgetKit is memory/time constrained; very large pixel snapshots can cause\n        // blank/empty renders when multiple widgets are on screen. Cap the scale.\n        options.scale = min(UIScreen.main.scale, 2.0)\n        options.mapType = .standard\n        options.pointOfInterestFilter = .excludingAll\n        options.showsBuildings = false\n        let region = region(for: coordinate, accuracy: device.accuracy)\n        options.region = region\n        options.traitCollection = UITraitCollection(userInterfaceStyle: style)\n\n        do {\n            let snapshot = try await MKMapSnapshotter(options: options).start()\n            let marker = markerImage(for: device, style: style, canvasSize: size)\n            let image = render(snapshot: snapshot, coordinate: coordinate, size: size, markerImage: marker)\n            if let data = image.pngData() {\n                try data.write(to: url, options: [.atomic])\n\n                #if canImport(WidgetKit)\n                // WidgetKit does not automatically refresh when a file on disk changes.\n                // Trigger a reload so the widget picks up the new snapshot immediately.\n                WidgetCenter.shared.reloadTimelines(ofKind: \"DeviceLocationMapWidget\")\n                #endif\n            }\n        } catch {\n            #if DEBUG\n            print(\"[Widget] Failed to generate map snapshot (\\(style == .dark ? \"dark\" : \"light\")) for \\(device.id): \\(error)\")\n            #endif\n        }\n    }\n\n    private static func region(for coordinate: CLLocationCoordinate2D, accuracy: Double?) -&gt; MKCoordinateRegion {\n        let baseMeters: CLLocationDistance = 4000\n        let extra = max(accuracy ?? 0, 0)\n        let radius = max(baseMeters, extra * 4)\n        return MKCoordinateRegion(\n            center: coordinate,\n            latitudinalMeters: radius,\n            longitudinalMeters: radius\n        )\n    }\n\n    private static func render(snapshot: MKMapSnapshotter.Snapshot,\n                               coordinate: CLLocationCoordinate2D,\n                               size: CGSize,",

        "contents": "    static func buildPayload(devices: [KnownDevice], locations: [CachedDeviceLocation], ownDeviceID: String) -&gt; WidgetSharedPayload {\n        var entries: [WidgetDeviceData] = []\n        var ownDevice: WidgetDeviceData?\n\n        for device in devices {\n            guard let location = locations.first(where: { $0.deviceID == device.DeviceID }) else { continue }\n            guard let entry = WidgetDeviceDataBuilder.makeEntry(device: device, location: location) else { continue }\n            entries.append(entry)\n            if device.DeviceID == ownDeviceID {\n                ownDevice = entry\n            }\n        }\n\n        return WidgetSharedPayload(\n            devices: entries,\n            ownDeviceID: ownDeviceID,\n            ownDevice: ownDevice\n        )\n    }\n}\n\n// MARK: - Helpers\n\nprivate enum WidgetDeviceDataBuilder {\n    static func makeEntry(device: KnownDevice, location: CachedDeviceLocation) -&gt; WidgetDeviceData? {\n        WidgetDeviceData(\n            id: device.DeviceID,\n            name: device.DeviceName,\n            latitude: location.latitude,\n            longitude: location.longitude,\n            locality: location.locality,\n            country: location.country,\n            timestamp: location.timestamp,\n            accuracy: location.accuracy,\n            color: WidgetColorFactory.color(from: device.DeviceColor)\n        )\n    }\n}\n\nprivate enum WidgetColorFactory {\n    static func color(from uiColor: UIColor?) -&gt; WidgetColor? {\n        guard let uiColor else { return nil }\n        var r: CGFloat = 0\n        var g: CGFloat = 0\n        var b: CGFloat = 0\n        var a: CGFloat = 0\n        uiColor.getRed(&amp;r, green: &amp;g, blue: &amp;b, alpha: &amp;a)\n        return WidgetColor(red: Double(r), green: Double(g), blue: Double(b), alpha: Double(a))\n    }\n}",

UIImage(systemName: \"mappin.circle.fill\") ?? UIImage()\n        }\n    }\n}",

        "contents": "    }\n\n    private func compute(region: MKCoordinateRegion, width: CGFloat) {\n        let usesMetric: Bool\n        if #available(iOS 16.0, *) {\n            usesMetric = Locale.current.measurementSystem == .metric\n        } else {\n            usesMetric = Locale.current.usesMetricSystem\n        }\n\n        // Bucket inputs to reduce recomputations and re-renders from tiny changes\n        let spanBucket = Self.bucketSpan(region.span.longitudeDelta)\n        let centerLatBucket = Self.bucketLatitude(region.center.latitude)\n        let widthBucket = Self.bucketWidth(width)\n        let key = CacheKey(spanBucket: spanBucket, centerLatBucket: centerLatBucket, widthBucket: widthBucket, isMetric: usesMetric)\n\n        if key == lastCacheKey {\n            return // Nothing significant changed\n        }\n\n        // Compute the raw distance for the given width\n        let distance = Self.distanceForWidth(region: region, width: width)\n        let label = Self.distanceLabel(for: distance)\n\n        DispatchQueue.main.async { [weak self] in\n            guard let self else { return }\n            self.lastCacheKey = key\n            self.label = label\n        }\n    }\n\n    // MARK: - Helpers\n\n    private static func bucketSpan(_ span: CLLocationDegrees) -&gt; Int {\n        // Log-scale bucket to keep the same bucket across tiny changes; 2 decimals in log10 space\n        let clamped = max(span, .leastNonzeroMagnitude)\n        let logScaled = log10(clamped)\n        return Int((logScaled * 100.0).rounded())\n    }\n\n    private static func bucketLatitude(_ latitude: CLLocationDegrees) -&gt; Int {\n        // Bucket by 1 degree; distance per longitude varies with cos(latitude)\n        return Int(latitude.rounded())\n    }\n\n    private static func bucketWidth(_ width: CGFloat) -&gt; Int {\n        // Pixel-level bucket\n        return Int(width.rounded())\n    }\n\n    private static func distanceForWidth(region: MKCoordinateRegion, width: CGFloat) -&gt;         "contents": "/*\n * Copyright (c) 2013-2025, Daniel Kirstenpfad, www.miataru.com\n *\n * WidgetMapSnapshotGenerator.swift\n * miataru\n *\n * Created by Daniel Kirstenpfad on 2026-01-06.\n */\n\nimport Foundation\nimport MapKit\nimport SwiftUI\n\n#if canImport(UIKit)\nimport UIKit\n#endif\n\n/// Generates pre-rendered map images (with a device marker) and writes them into\n/// the shared App Group container for WidgetKit consumption.\nenum WidgetMapSnapshotGenerator {\n    static func generateSnapshot(for device: KnownDevice, location: CachedDeviceLocation, size: CGSize = CGSize(width: 400, height: 400)) {\n        Task.detached(priority: .utility) {\n            let coordinate = CLLocationCoordinate2D(latitude: location.latitude, longitude: location.longitude)\n\n            // Render both light and dark variants so widgets can pick based on appearance.\n            await renderSnapshot(for: device, location: location, coordinate: coordinate, size: size, style: .light)\n            await renderSnapshot(for: device, location: location, coordinate: coordinate, size: size, style: .dark)\n        }\n    }\n\n    @MainActor\n    private static func renderSnapshot(for device: KnownDevice, location: CachedDeviceLocation, coordinate: CLLocationCoordinate2D, size: CGSize, style: UIUserInterfaceStyle) async {\n        guard let url = SharedWidgetDataManager.mapSnapshotURL(for: device.DeviceID, style: style) else { return }",
